llms:
muse-assist is an early-alpha Red Cup Engineering project to design personal, virtual and executive assistance as a specialized server on MetroPlat, the 561 Group's agentic-enterprise platform. It is not released: there is no hosted assistant and no supported public package, and the licence is undecided. Meta's Muse is a separate product and is only a reference. This site states design targets and what evidence exists, and claims no parity or measured advantage.

## How to use this site

There is nothing to install or sign in to. Read the pages below; the feeds list dated changes.

## Pages

- [muse-assist](https://muse.561.group/): What the project is, its design targets and its release state.
- [Development method and status](https://muse.561.group/development/): How the design is derived from customer demand and what remains unaccepted.
